title: Flexbox

sections.content: Flexbox lays out items in a row or column with alignment control: justify-content (main axis), align-items (cross axis), gap for spacing.
It replaced float hacks for navbars, card rows, and centering. flex: 1 makes items share space equally.
Key points: flex-direction changes axis, flex-wrap allows multiple lines, and align-self overrides align-items per item.
Summary: Flexbox — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.
